viewing_check: Confirm date and mintmark (1780 SF or X) and edge lettering (Justicio Clementia); check weight (about 28 g) and that the loop is solder rather than a drilled hole; note any cleaning or damage. A loop reduces collector value, so expect bullion-plus pricing.
